none.description:
{Rune of Thunder}

Places the Rune of Thunder upon an allied unit, granting them a 25% chance to cast Thunderbolt after attacking, with damage dependent on unit level:

{1}: 2 Damage per unit, {2}: 3 Damage per unit, {3}: 4 Damage per unit
{4}: 5 Damage per unit, {5}: 10 Damage per unit, {6}: 15 Damage per unit
{7+}: 25 Damage per unit
